test_tensor_dict_from_tree: test creating a TensorDict from a nested dictionary of torch tensors using from_tree
test_tensor_dict_to_tree: test converting a TensorDict back to a nested dictionary of tensors using to_tree
test_tensor_dict_string_indexing: test accessing and assigning values in a TensorDict using string key indexing
test_tensor_dict_numeric_indexing: test assigning indexed slices of a TensorDict using integer or slice indexing with strict mode
test_tensor_dict_map: test applying a lambda function across all leaf tensors in a TensorDict using map and map_in_place
